final: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(remaining) as overall_avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE remaining IS NOT NULL), event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) as avg_spent, AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT event_averages.link_to_event, event_averages.avg_spent, event_averages.avg_remaining, (event_averages.avg_remaining - overall_avg.overall_avg_remaining) as difference_above_overall_avg FROM event_averages, overall_avg ORDER BY CASE WHEN (event_averages.avg_remaining - overall_avg.overall_avg_remaining) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, (event_averages.avg_remaining - overall_avg.overall_avg_remaining) DESC LIMIT 10
